overlap: Build official regular5m bar-end grid. Per query interval from first bar end strictly after common entry_at to max(SOXL.exit_at,SOXS.exit_at), inclusive. Both exits must lie on the grid. Pair is one interval because C,D depend on both sides; not two independent observations. For selected maturity-approved IDs only, c_b counts their intervals covering b; u_i=mean(1/c_b) over interval i. No future or pending paths enter c_b. Weekends/closed hours are absent. This weights price-path dependence, not T+1 settlement or dividend cash occupation. Overnight price changes are included in next session first bar. Interval may conservatively include data unused by the earlier exiting leg.
